core_claims.name: ContextuallyEquivalent / BetaContextuallyEquivalent
core_claims.scope: For arbitrary scoped terms, quantify every well-scoped single-hole closing Ctx n 0. The two definitions observe respectively existence of substitution-based weak call-by-name lambda evaluation and existence of full beta reduction to a lambda.

core_claims.name: denotEqualConverges / contextualEquivalence
core_claims.scope: Pointwise semantic equality of arbitrary open terms implies preservation and reflection of closed weak call-by-name convergence after plugging into every closing context. The proof uses established compositionality, soundness, and adequacy rather than a supplied adequacy field.

core_claims.name: denotEqualTerminates / betaContextualEquivalence
core_claims.scope: Semantic equality implies the upstream contextual-equivalence observation stated with arbitrary full beta paths to some lambda. The result quantifies all closing contexts and adds no typing or normalization hypothesis.

core_claims.name: reduceReplacement / betaReplacement / underBinderReplacement
core_claims.scope: Any finite full beta reduction, including contraction under a lambda, yields contextual equivalence under all closing contexts. Open beta redexes are supported by scope-indexed contexts.

core_claims.name: etaNotContextual
core_claims.scope: Omega is not contextually equivalent to lambda x. Omega x for weak-head convergence; the empty context separates them, using EvalLam and the proved impossibility of evaluating Omega.

exercises.scope: Replace a beta redex beneath a lambda and generalize to every finite full beta path.
Prove all equivalence-relation laws by pointwise transport of convergence evidence at each context.
Refute unrestricted eta replacement by distinguishing Omega from its lambda eta expansion with the hole context.

deviations: The upstream full-beta observation is retained as BetaContextuallyEquivalent; an additional equivalent weak call-by-name observation is exposed as ContextuallyEquivalent.
Explicit evidence-transport functions replace Agda iff notation; no function extensionality is needed.
The eta counterexample and equivalence-relation exercises are additional checked material. No converse from contextual equivalence to semantic equality, or full abstraction theorem, is claimed.
